title: Accurate Mob Sizes
description: The Accurate Mob Sizes datapack makes most real-life mobs closer to their actual size, making Minecraft feel a bit more realistic.
body:
![Some examples of the reduced size mobs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/57b7d73e9aea3ceb5c04619e2b824865a5d099c8.jpeg)

**Accurate Mob Sizes changes the size of most real-life mobs to better match their actual proportions.**

Ever thought some animals in Minecraft felt way too big or way too small? This datapack fixes that by resizing many mobs to be closer to their real-world size, making the game feel a little more realistic.

To keep gameplay fun, some mobs aren't scaled to their exact real-life size, so fighting them doesn't become annoying or impossible.

Current mobs that are modified:\
Spider, Cave Spider, Bee, Wolf, Silverfish, Rabbit, Axolotl, Turtle, Frog, Snow Golem, Armadillo, Cod, Cow, Dolphin, Donkey, Fox, Goat, Mule, Panda, Ocelot, Pig, Polar Bear, Pufferfish, Sheep, Squid, Glow Squid, Villager, Zombie Villager, Zombie, Husk, Drowned, Parched
